scope: All 12 horizontal seam QA strips of assembly_hardcut, each with 160 native pixels on either side
reviewMethod: Actual visual inspection of all twelve original-size PNG strips; no numerical threshold substituted for image review. No source or assembly pixels modified.

segments.reviewScale: native 1:1; original detail, no contact resampling
segments.content: 灰白柱基、后栏杆基座与米白桥面相接；阴影和斜石缝连续。
segments.colorJoin: 未见贯穿横线；局部米白材质明暗变化未形成色块台阶。
segments.contourJoin: 柱基外轮廓、阴影边和斜石缝均无明显断线。
segments.recommendedMethod: retain current native hard-cut pixels; no tone, dp_tone or AI needed for this reviewed seam

scopedFinding: No blocking horizontal seam defect seen. Do not apply blanket tone correction or AI redraw to horizontal edges.

conditionalGuidance.boundedTone: Only reconsider after whole-tile review identifies a reproducible axis-aligned color step; mask by existing material and bound support, rather than adjusting normal painted plane changes. None specifically required by these 12 strips.
conditionalGuidance.dp_tone: Only use if independent junction/vertical review identifies a shared endpoint issue that also touches a horizontal seam. No mandatory horizontal cell:top key from this review.
conditionalGuidance.AI: No horizontal outline break or missing structure requiring AI repair was observed.

remainingScope: 9 four-patch junctions, vertical and outer-edge reviews are handled separately.
Whole-tile water uniformity and navigation/client validation remain separate requirements.
